sloka: संध्या राग उत्थितैः ताम्रैः अंतेषु अधिक पाण्डुरैः ।स्निग्धैः अभ्र पट च्छेदैः बद्ध व्रणम् इव अंबरम् ॥४-२८-५॥
transliteration: saṁdhyā rāga utthitaiḥ tāmraiḥ aṁteṣu adhika pāṇḍuraiḥ ।snigdhaiḥ abhra paṭa cchedaiḥ baddha vraṇam iva aṁbaram ॥4-28-5॥

translations.english: 'The sky looks as though its wounds are dressed with pale white moistureladen bandage cloths of clouds, red in the border, tinged as they are with the glow of twilight.
